scientific_limitations: Exact formulas are restricted to balanced simple nearest-neighbor bridges and unweighted squared-position energy.
The all-subsets conditioning event specifies zero contacts but allows additional contacts.
No stochastic ordering or joint limit theorem is claimed; the correlation asymptotic follows directly from exact moments.
Full-text historical comparison with Knight (2000) could not be completed; its absolute-area observable differs from the squared-area observable.
title: Zero contacts suppress quadratic energy in symmetric random-walk bridges
